RESOLVED via WebSearch research (this session): the specific CPEC digital-backbone project is the Pakistan-China Cross-Border Optical Fiber Cable Project (Rawalpindi to Khunjerab Pass, ~820km). Counterparty is the Special Communications Organization (SCO) of Pakistan, which jointly operates and maintains the cable with China Telecom; Huawei was the EPC (engineering, procurement, construction) contractor. China provided a $44m concessional loan for the project -- reported here as the disclosed value since no other headline contract value was found; this is a loan amount, not necessarily the full project cost. Distinct from Huawei's general 1998 market entry into Pakistan, which should not be conflated with this specific project.
